scope: Validation advisories with continued safe publication, remembered processing mode and saved custom levels, readable Windows paths, version metadata and release documentation.

review.execution: Sequential main-thread review as required by AGENTS.md; no independent or cross-model review claimed.
checks: Only post-conversion validation problems become advisories. Cancellation and conversion failures still stop processing; exclusive publication and workspace ownership checks remain authoritative.
Failed validation remains null in stored history; success is recorded only after publication. Advisory logs retain safe reasons without tool commands or processing expressions.
Existing history reloads without losing advisory logs or successful output paths; missing output cannot be reported as saved.
Mode persistence stores the selected preset only; active batch settings take priority, unknown presets fall back, and storage errors preserve the current choice.
Saved custom levels continue using the native settings store; canceled drafts do not replace saved values.
Windows path formatting affects display only, including drive and UNC forms; IPC, file identities and native file access retain original paths.

localVerification.frontend: 73 tests passed; production build and TypeScript checks passed before the version metadata update.
localVerification.backend: Full non-ignored Rust suite, format checks and desktop-feature clippy passed with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 after an external-volume incremental-cache failure.
localVerification.reportedSample: The supplied read-only video passed the new real-media regression: custom recommended settings, speed disabled, audio validation warning recorded, output saved, source identity unchanged. Sample media and processing parameters are not included in the release.

coverageLimits: Mode restart behavior is covered by frontend remount with persisted localStorage; custom levels are covered by native settings-store reload. Full installed-app restart remains a manual acceptance step.
Local reported-sample regression ran on macOS Intel; the private original is not uploaded to Windows CI.
Final same-commit dual-platform build, installed-resource checks and installed-media evidence must pass before publication.
Signing, notarization and complete clean-machine desktop acceptance remain NOT VERIFIED.
